subject: English
question_text: Complete the following incomplete story with your own
stimulus: imagination. Write new ten sentences to complete the story. 1×10=10 Once there was a poor farmer. One day, he bought a goose from the market. The goose began to lay a golden egg everyday. The poor farmer became very rich within very short time. But he was a very greedy person-----------.
